title: Deep Shrines / Shrine of Order
locations: Songseeker Mines, through the passage containing mudskippers
Temple of Hearts, first large shrine on the left towards the Shrine of Yun'Shul

requirements.oath_requirement: No Oath (Oathless is allowed, but taken Oaths must be broken with penalty)

core_mechanics.effect: Averages user invested attribute points across all stats with at least 1 point invested.
core_mechanics.max_stat_loss_limit: Core attributes (STR, FTD, AGI, INT, WLL, CHA) and Weapon stats cannot lose more than 25 investment points from Shrine of Order. Attunement stats can lose any amount of points.
core_mechanics.racial_base_floor_rule: Racial innate starting stats (e.g., Canor Str 3, Cha 2) cannot be reduced by Shrine of Order. The stat can never drop below the race's starting baseline.
core_mechanics.free_points_return: Any points that cannot be evenly distributed during the averaging process are returned to the player as free investment points.
core_mechanics.talent_retention: Talents acquired Pre-Shrine (e.g. Reinforced Armor, Ghost, Showstopper, Collapsed Lung, Underdog) remain permanently active even if stats drop below requirement.
core_mechanics.talent_exceptions: Attunement Adept/Expert/Master and Attunement Unbound talents disappear if the attunement attribute falls below requirement.
core_mechanics.mantra_downgrade: Mantra upgrade stars/levels downgrade to the appropriate level if requirement is no longer met.
core_mechanics.equipment_unequip: Equipment and weapons unequip automatically if the character no longer meets the stat requirements.

pre_shrine_meta_strategy: Invest heavily into high-requirement survivability and utility talents before Shrine (e.g. Fortitude 90 for Reinforced Armor, Agility 40 for Ghost, Charisma 15 for Tough Love, Willpower 30 for Underdog). After ordering, redistribute points to max out primary weapon (100) and attunement (80).
